question: Why did Jansen evolve his Strandbeest legs instead of testing every design?
answer: Testing all trillions of possible designs would take about 100,000 years of computer time. Breeding the flattest footpaths 1,500 at a time took months instead, until 13 "holy numbers" came out. Tapping lets the flattest footpaths breed, so each generation keeps the best designs.
move: Can't test them all? Breed the best.

web.label: Astute free card, tap to evolve. Asks why Jansen evolved his Strandbeest legs instead of testing every design. Shows generation 1 with 1,500 tried, next to a testing-them-all option of trillions. Tap to breed generation 2.
